Top matches by filter fit Candidates matching your criteria — not a recommendation. Ranked by fit to your four filters plus weekly-chain liquidity (nearest expiry ≥7 days out). Tap a card for the breakdown.

Trendline breaks (context only)
  • Timeframes: weekly, daily, 65m, 15m. "s" = short horizon, "b" = broader horizon. Lines join the two latest causally confirmed swing highs (descending resistance, R) or lows (rising support, S).
  • A break needs a completed-bar close beyond the line by 0.25×ATR14; later bars mark holding / retest held / failed. Partial periods are excluded; 65m and 15m bars are built from 5m regular-session data anchored at the 9:30 ET open.
  • Not part of the filter-fit score or pass status.
  • Break quality chip (per timeframe, highest-scoring latest break across short/broad lines): 0–100 = touches (max 40) + time held (max 35) + break volume (max 25); ≥75 strong, 50–74 moderate, <50 weak; failed to hold = 0. Display only — no effect on fit score, pass status or sort.
  • A break is not proof a trend has reversed. n/a = data unavailable or history too short.
How the filter-fit score works (0–100)
  • Support (20): full if price is −3% to +5% vs nearest support (50d/200d MA, 52w low, 3m swing low); fades to 0 at 10 pts outside.
  • IV rank (20): full at 35, linear to 0 at 0 or 70. >60 flagged “premium too rich”, <15 “cheap but possibly no catalyst”.
  • Upside (15): % to average analyst target, full at +50%; 0 unless consensus is Buy or Strong Buy.
  • Pullback (15): deeper of 1m/3m drawdown. Full at −25%, 60% at −10%/−40%, fades to 0 outside; 0 if down 50%+ in a month.
  • Liquidity (30): near-ATM call in the nearest expiry ≥7 days: OI (15, log scale, full at 5,000) + spread (15, full at ≤5% of mid, 0 at ≥25%). “Liquid” = spread ≤10% and OI ≥500.
Δ≈0.45 strike uses Black-Scholes delta from the chain IV. Implied move = ATM IV × √(days/365). ⚑E = earnings date falls before that expiry. Numbers only — the score measures fit to your criteria, not future returns.

Weekly puts Candidates matching your criteria — not a recommendation. Three filters; fit adds put liquidity. Same expiry rule as calls (nearest ≥7 days out).

How the put screen works
  • Filters (all 3 to pass; 1 miss = near-miss): resistance — price 0–3% below a 3-month swing high, the 52-week high, or the 50/200-day MA when rising toward it from below; overextension (O3) — up 10–40% from the 1–3 month low or 10–40% above the 50-day MA, excluded if up ≥50% in one month; IV rank 20–50 (>60 “premium too rich”, <15 “cheap but possibly no catalyst”).
  • Fit score (0–100): resistance 25, IV rank 25 (full at 35), overextension 20 (full at +25%), put liquidity 30 (ATM put OI log scale full at 5,000 = 15; spread full ≤5%, 0 at ≥25% = 15). Liquidity is score-only, not a pass filter. “Liquid put weekly” = ATM put spread ≤10% of mid and OI ≥500.
  • Analyst consensus/upside: shown for information only — no filter, no points.
Sources: prices, moving averages, option chains (live bid/ask), analyst consensus & targets, earnings dates from Yahoo Finance (yfinance); IV rank = live 30d ATM IV vs 1y Unusual Whales history. Missing data shows as “—”. Candidates matching your criteria — not a recommendation, not financial advice.
